# Test audio

- `speech.wav`: generated for these tests with ElevenLabs text-to-speech.
- The real fan recording the tests use is `static/sounds/fan_normal.ogg`; see `static/sounds/CREDITS.md`.
- `isolated_talk.flac`: what the ElevenLabs Voice Isolator returned for `talking(0)` in `test_isolate.py`,
  sent as three 5 s clips starting 7.5 s into the fan; a regression check against its real, imperfect output.
